# FLX-3302: a required expose column has no runtime attribute mapped onto it

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A scenario-driven emit renders each moment onto the expose's declared columns through the mapping :mod:`flux_engine.seam.mapping` resolves: an alias declared for the vertical, an override declared on the emit, or the column's own name matching a runtime attribute. A column the contract marks required that none of those three resolve leaves the row with no value to place, and a required column may not be null (FLX-3202) -- so the run is refused where the mapping is decided, before a row exists, rather than on every row it would produce. Declare the source under the emit's mapping block, or add the column to the vertical's alias table.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3302
```
